gap_findings.real_llm_provider_available: unknown/ollama_cloud configured but not reachable in this test
gap_findings.intent_classification_granularity: coarse (QUERY/direct_assistant); missing required intents like explain_capabilities, repo_read, dashboard_diagnosis, code_change_request, push_request, delete_request, memory_read, memory_write, autonomy_dryrun, self_improvement_reportonly, trading_broker_live
gap_findings.governance_blocks_unsafe_actions: partial: write tools blocked in read_only, but no explicit policy for trading/IBKR, delete, memory-write, autonomy, self-improvement

root_causes: LangGraphParityRuntimeV2._finalizer_node uses _deterministic_finalizer and reports provider_used='deterministic_parity_finalizer' instead of calling finalize_agent_run.
LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 has no list_capabilities implementation, causing /v2/agent/capabilities 500.
AgentV2IntentAdapter.select_route returns legacy intents (CONVERSATION/QUERY/COMMAND) and routes (direct_assistant/brain_evidence/operational_agent), not the required NL intent taxonomy.
Governance has no explicit policy table for trading/IBKR, delete, memory-write, autonomy, self-improvement; escalation only checks mode + write tool names.

api_adapter.py capabilities endpoint calls rt.list_capabilities() without guarding missing method and does not include required keys like real_llm_available, trading_broker_allowed, memory_write_allowed, supported_intents, known_gaps.

risk_assessment.real_llm_gap: P1_BLOCKER for 'real agent' acceptance; parity finalizer is currently primary.
